text:
Follow-Through
the tail of a deal, run by each side's own agent

You type your side: role, goal, written authority limit,
and one thing the other side cannot see.
A You.com search puts one public price line on both cards.

Your agent (Claude) and their agent (GPT) talk in plain prose.
No shared tool. Each stays inside its written authority.

Each side writes its own record, then the fields are diffed,
and a third model and a CrewAI crew audit both sides blind.

Next actions are drafted. A person approves, One sends the email.
Nothing leaves without a person.

A rejection becomes a lesson,
written once and recalled on the next run.

Scoring replays in a Daytona sandbox. Only the records go in.
